comments.author: gtc
comments.body_html:
Having trouble trying to create a container that uses a non-container item (can of Majaica beans) as a base template cause ItemGen shows no grids defined.

And I’m not sure how to do it the other way around where I use a vanilla container (eg Lucky Scav) as template and override the bundles and icon with another vanilla item, or if thats even possible.

comments.author: shaneeexd
comments.body_html:
Yes you can do it the other way around, by using a normal container and using the vanilla bundle path, in your case “assets/content/items/barter/item_barter_other_coffee/item_barter_other_coffee.bundle”

then just make sure to change the width and height to whatever you want it to be (this is the size of it in stash etc), which I would assume you will set to 1x1, and the cells is what determines the size of the container slots

only issue right now is the icon is not shrunk with the size you set (actual slot functionality is fine) so I will make a small update on the client side, but for now you can still make them and it will fix after the update

Edit: Update is now out so above issue is fixed

comments.author: AtonicX
comments.body_html:
Found an interesting quirk:

Using the Leave-it-there mod (Built from source on the github, the version on the Forge is not up to date yet), having a generated container from ItemGen, and then trying to use those containers with LiT seems to cause rollback errors.

Testing was as follows: Brought a Custom Container into raid and to extract > No Rollback Placed down a custom container and put items into container > Rollback Placed down container, left > No Rollback Placed down container, left, came back and put items into container > Rollback

With the Rollbacks, I got a blank error at the end of the raid, and then it acted like an Alt-F4, all progress in raid was lost.

I already reported this to Jehree as it may be an issue with LiT and the build currently from source, but I figured I would leave this report here as well to look into.
